scanNote:
PHOTO FILE - UNIT 4, 2-KARTA (raqamsiz bet, pdf 148). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 4'. Qizil sarlavha 'The Waterfall'.

TO'RT RASM va to'ldiriladigan matn:
1-RASM: Dan va Mark (qizil hayot jiletlarida) kanoeni daryoga surmoqda. Mark: 'Where's the map?' Matn: 'One morning Dan and Mark pushed their canoe ......' (6 qator)
2-RASM: daryo bo'yida ikkalasi kruzhkalarda kofe ichmoqda, shoxda rangli qush (zarg'aldoq) o'tiribdi. Matn: 'Later, they stopped to have a cup of hot coffee. ......' (6 qator)
3-RASM: tez oqimda kanoe, oldinda sharshara ko'rinmoqda. Dan: 'Oh, no! A waterfall!' Matn: 'A short while later they decided to turn around. "Oh, no! ......' (7 qator)
4-RASM: qirg'oqda ikki baliqchi arqon tashlamoqda, kanoedagilar ushlab olmoqda. Matn: '"Here! Catch!" someone shouted. Two fishermen ......' (6 qator)

⚠ Bu 4-unitdagi hikoya yozish mashqi (rasmlar bo'yicha).

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 4: The Waterfall (picture story)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the four pictures and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: To'rt rasmga qarang va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMLAR:
  1 Dan va Mark kanoeni daryoga
    suryapti. Mark: "Where's the
    map?" (xarita qani?)
  2 Ular to'xtab kofe ichmoqda;
    shoxda rangli qush
    (kingfisher - zarg'aldoq)
  3 Tez oqim, oldinda SHARSHARA.
    Dan: 'Oh, no! A waterfall!'
  4 Ikki baliqchi qirg'oqdan arqon
    tashlaydi: 'Here! Catch!'


⚠ 'A CANOE':

  = kanoe (yengil qayiq).
  /kəˈnuː/.


⚠ 'A WATERFALL':

  = sharshara.


⚠ 'A KINGFISHER':

  = zarg'aldoq (baliqchi qush).


⚠ 'A FISHERMAN':

  = baliqchi. Ko'plik 'fishermen'.


⚠ 'TO TURN AROUND':

  = orqaga burilmoq.

items.en: 1 What are Dan and Mark doing? What does Mark ask?
items.uz: 1 Dan va Mark nima qilmoqda? Mark nima so'raydi?
items.answerEn: They are pushing their canoe into the river. Mark asks where the map is.
items.answerUz: Ular kanoeni daryoga surmoqda. Mark xarita qayerdaligini so'raydi.

items.en: 2 Why did they stop? What can you see on the branch?
items.uz: 2 Ular nega to'xtadi? Shoxda nimani ko'ryapsiz?
items.answerEn: They stopped to have a cup of hot coffee. There's a colourful kingfisher on the branch.
items.answerUz: Ular issiq kofe ichish uchun to'xtadi. Shoxda rangli zarg'aldoq bor.

items.en: 3 What is the problem in picture 3?
items.answerEn: The river is moving fast and there is a waterfall ahead.
items.answerUz: Daryo tez oqmoqda va oldinda sharshara bor.

items.answerEn: Two fishermen on the bank throw them a rope and pull them to safety.
items.answerUz: Qirg'oqdagi ikki baliqchi ularga arqon tashlab, xavfsiz joyga tortib oladi.

structure.modelEn: One morning Dan and Mark pushed their canoe into the river. The sun was shining and the water was calm. "Where's the map?" Mark asked. "I think I left it in the car," Dan said. "Never mind, we'll be fine."
structure.modelUz: Bir kuni ertalab Dan va Mark kanoelarini daryoga surdi. Quyosh charaqlab turar, suv sokin edi. "Xarita qani?" - so'radi Mark. "Mashinada qoldirdim shekilli, - dedi Dan. - Hechqisi yo'q, hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi."

structure.modelEn: Later, they stopped to have a cup of hot coffee. While they were drinking, they watched a beautiful kingfisher on a branch. They didn't notice that the river was getting faster.
structure.modelUz: Keyinroq ular bir chashka issiq kofe ichish uchun to'xtadi. Ichayotganlarida shoxdagi chiroyli zarg'aldoqni tomosha qilishdi. Daryo tezlashayotganini payqashmadi.

structure.modelEn: A short while later they decided to turn around. "Oh, no! A waterfall!" Dan shouted. The current was very strong and they couldn't paddle back. The canoe was moving faster and faster towards the waterfall.
structure.modelUz: Biroz vaqt o'tib ular orqaga burilishga qaror qildi. "Voy, yo'q! Sharshara!" - qichqirdi Dan. Oqim juda kuchli edi va ular orqaga eshkak esha olmadi. Kanoe sharshara tomon tobora tez harakatlanardi.

structure.modelEn: "Here! Catch!" someone shouted. Two fishermen on the river bank threw them a rope. Dan caught it and the fishermen pulled the canoe to safety. "Thank you! You saved our lives!" the boys said. Next time, they will remember to take the map.
structure.modelUz: "Mana! Ushla!" - deb qichqirdi kimdir. Daryo qirg'og'idagi ikki baliqchi ularga arqon tashladi. Dan uni ushlab oldi va baliqchilar kanoeni xavfsiz joyga tortib oldi. "Rahmat! Hayotimizni saqlab qoldingiz!" - dedi bolalar. Keyingi safar ular xaritani olishni eslab qolishadi.

modelAnswers:
The Waterfall

One morning Dan and Mark pushed their canoe into the river. The sun was shining and the water was calm. "Where's the map?" Mark asked. "I think I left it in the car," Dan said. "Never mind, we'll be fine."

Later, they stopped to have a cup of hot coffee. While they were drinking, they watched a beautiful kingfisher on a branch. They didn't notice that the river was getting faster.

A short while later they decided to turn around. "Oh, no! A waterfall!" Dan shouted. The current was very strong and they couldn't paddle back. The canoe was moving faster and faster towards the waterfall.

"Here! Catch!" someone shouted. Two fishermen on the river bank threw them a rope. Dan caught it and the fishermen pulled the canoe to safety. "Thank you! You saved our lives!" the boys said. Next time, they will remember to take the map.
modelAnswersUz:
Sharshara

Bir kuni ertalab Dan va Mark kanoelarini daryoga surdi. Quyosh charaqlab turar, suv sokin edi. "Xarita qani?" - so'radi Mark. "Mashinada qoldirdim shekilli, - dedi Dan. - Hechqisi yo'q, hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi."

Keyinroq ular bir chashka issiq kofe ichish uchun to'xtadi. Ichayotganlarida shoxdagi chiroyli zarg'aldoqni tomosha qilishdi. Daryo tezlashayotganini payqashmadi.

Biroz vaqt o'tib ular orqaga burilishga qaror qildi. "Voy, yo'q! Sharshara!" - qichqirdi Dan. Oqim juda kuchli edi va ular orqaga eshkak esha olmadi. Kanoe sharshara tomon tobora tez harakatlanardi.

"Mana! Ushla!" - deb qichqirdi kimdir. Daryo qirg'og'idagi ikki baliqchi ularga arqon tashladi. Dan uni ushlab oldi va baliqchilar kanoeni xavfsiz joyga tortib oldi. "Rahmat! Hayotimizni saqlab qoldingiz!" - dedi bolalar. Keyingi safar ular xaritani olishni eslab qolishadi.
